proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H K hH hK hc
  have h0 : (H ⊓ K).index ≠ 0 := Subgroup.index_inf_ne_zero hH hK
  have d1 : H.index ∣ (H ⊓ K).index := Subgroup.index_dvd_of_le inf_le_left
  have d2 : K.index ∣ (H ⊓ K).index := Subgroup.index_dvd_of_le inf_le_right
  exact Nat.le_antisymm Subgroup.index_inf_le (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0) (hc.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd d1 d2))
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H K : Subgroup G), H.index ≠ 0 → K.index ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime H.index K.index → (H ⊓ K).index = H.index * K.index
